text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from roughly 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling, fewer late-night CRM updates.

**2. Notes improved, not just sped up.** Next steps and objections were captured consistently, so handoffs to solutions engineers got cleaner.

**3. Trust took work.** Customers asked about recording. Reps who explained it upfront saw almost no pushback.

**4. Adoption followed managers.** Teams whose leads reviewed summaries in pipeline meetings stuck with it.

The tool didn't replace judgment. It protected attention for the conversation itself.

What's one admin task you'd happily hand off?

*(Scenario is synthetic; figures are illustrative.)*
